title: oberna alpina
intro: Oberna alpina, commonly known as the Alpine Toadflax, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Oberna alpina include its ability to relax the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
